body.title: Recovery in South Carolina. All 46 Counties.
paragraphs: Greenville, Richland, Charleston, Horry, and Spartanburg counties generate the highest volume of South Carolina foreclosure surplus cases. South Carolina is a judicial foreclosure state, and foreclosure sales are typically conducted by the Master-in-Equity or Clerk of Court. Surplus funds from these sales are held by the court until claimed by the former owner. South Carolina tax sale overages are held by county treasurers and are one of the most valuable surplus categories in the state.

The South Carolina Unclaimed Property Program, administered by the State Treasurer, holds hundreds of millions in dormant bank accounts, insurance proceeds, uncashed checks, and other assets belonging to South Carolina residents. RCG searches South Carolina court records, county tax sale records, and state unclaimed property databases for every South Carolina client.
body.callout: Claims are filed through our network of licensed attorneys in South Carolina. All recoveries are handled on a pure contingency basis with no upfront cost to the client.
